title: Skyforge Aeronautics
description: Industrial Create survival with airships, automation, factories, and multiplayer exploration.
body:
Skyforge Aeronautics is a Create Aeronautics survival server focused on airships, automation, engineering, exploration, and large-scale multiplayer builds. Build massive factories, design flying machines, and conquer the skies in a Create-powered world.
